...and it clicks on a real keyboard switch.

steps.label: FIRST PRINT
captions: The first print, all in white, to test it.

captions: It clicked fine, but the lid just sat on top, loose.

steps.label: VERSION 2

steps.label: THEN A CANISTER

steps.label: AFTER THAT PRINT
captions: Now: a 1.86 mm seam and a deeper, coarser 4 mm thread...
...and a guide ring, so the lid can't cross-thread.

captions: ...and a guide ring, so the lid can't cross-thread.

steps.label: TODAY
